title: Longest downhill trail across an elevation grid
insight: LeetCode 329 Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix: memoized DFS (or DP over cells sorted by elevation) so each cell's best trail is computed once, O(rows*cols)
prompt: For the trail-planning tool, please implement LongestDescent in descent.go. README.md gives the contract and the 500 x 500 performance target, including grids where one trail winds through every cell. Keep the package name and the exported signature, use only the standard library, and make sure `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` pass; feel free to add your own tests.
